prose: MuscleMemory is an Apache-2.0 open-source tool that gives coding agents procedural memory. Agents relearn the same things each session: which files to open, how tests run, what broke before. It watches the agent work, and when a task truly succeeds (tests pass after the last change) it records how the task was done.
It is local by default and also learns from failures.
highlights: Learns from successful and failed agent runs.
